A '''Gamorrean''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] served on the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstrel''-class space yacht]], during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. When the ''Jewel's'' [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] captured the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]], the Gamorrean and [[Unidentified Gamorrean (Star Jewel)|another]] escorted Katarn to the ship's beast pit, which held Jabba's favorite [[Kell dragon/Legends|Kell dragon]]. After Katarn took part in an ill-fated discussion with Jabba the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] over a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], the two Gamorreans pushed Katarn into the pit. The agent was stronger than they realized, however, when Katarn killed the dragon with his bare hands. Katarn eventually rescued his partner, [[Jan Ors]], and together they escaped the ''Star Jewel''.
